Accessibility AI

Catch accessibility issues that can be detected reliably from stored HTML, then use AI only for semantic questions such as alternative-text quality or heading clarity.

Supported scope
Sections, Page, Book, Label, Assignment and Forum content
Design focus
Assistance, not certification
Built as a Moodle plugin first: permissions, native APIs and human review remain part of the workflow instead of being replaced by an external black box.
Practical results
Production-minded
✓
Local HTML rules
Detect missing alt text, heading jumps, weak links, table-header problems, duplicate IDs, iframe titles and other concrete issues.
✓
Semantic review
Ask AI about alt-text meaning, link clarity, heading wording and textual complexity only where context is needed.
✓
Human edit path
Every finding points back to Moodle-controlled source locations; content is never changed automatically.
Learner content excluded
Submissions, forum posts, quiz attempts, private files and other learner-generated content are outside version 1.
Conservative contrast checks
Only explicit, locally computable foreground/background combinations are evaluated.
No false certification
An empty report is never presented as proof of WCAG conformance.
What this plugin does

Accessibility AI follows a simple rule: do not spend AI tokens on things PHP can know from the HTML. The deterministic engine handles concrete markup problems first, while AI handles semantic judgement that depends on surrounding language.

The semantic payload is minimized, item IDs are whitelisted, model markup is stripped and AI-provided edit URLs are ignored. This keeps the model in an advisory role rather than allowing it to invent navigation or write course content.

Features you get
Image and link checks
Review alternative text and accessible link wording.
Heading and table checks
Detect structural patterns that often break navigation for assistive technology.
Media indicators
Flag audio/video content without locally detectable captions or transcript signals.
Semantic suggestions
Produce human-review suggestions for clarity and descriptions.
Strict item allowlist
Reject AI results that refer to content items outside the current request.
Moodle capability control
Require the dedicated audit capability at course context.

Also requires AI Bridge.
